raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.98.13"

package:
  name: opcua
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/o/opcua/opcua-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3352f30b5fed863146a82778aaf09faa5feafcb9dd446a4f49ff34c0c3ebbde6

build:
  script: python -m pip install . -vv
  number: 7
  skip:
    - ppc64le
  python:
    entry_points:
      - uabrowse = opcua.tools:uals
      - uacall = opcua.tools:uacall
      - uaclient = opcua.tools:uaclient
      - uadiscover = opcua.tools:uadiscover
      - uahistoryread = opcua.tools:uahistoryread
      - uals = opcua.tools:uals
      - uaread = opcua.tools:uaread
      - uaserver = opcua.tools:uaserver
      - uasubscribe = opcua.tools:uasubscribe
      - uawrite = opcua.tools:uawrite

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != host_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
        - pip
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - cryptography
    - lxml
    - python
    - python-dateutil
    - pytz

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - opcua
        - opcua.client
        - opcua.common
        - opcua.crypto
        - opcua.server
        - opcua.ua
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - uabrowse -h
      - uacall -h
      - uaclient -h
      - uadiscover -h
      - uahistoryread -h
      - uals -h
      - uaread -h
      - uaserver -h
      - uasubscribe -h
      - uawrite -h

about:
  homepage: http://freeopcua.github.io/
  summary: 'LGPL Pure Python OPC-UA Client and Server'
  license: LGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  documentation: https://python-opcua.readthedocs.io
  repository: https://github.com/FreeOpcUa/python-opcua

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - m-rossi
